title: Diagonal language for a machine
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $W$ over the Boolean alphabet and a function $g : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, define a language of finite binary strings by declaring $x$ to belong to it exactly when $W$ does not compute the one-bit output $1$ on input $x$ within $g(|x|)$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $W$ over the Boolean alphabet
